summary.zh: 先要格挡与命中：盾牌壁垒提供格挡爆发，精确保证仇恨技能不落空，盾牌专精第 1 点把格挡转化为法力。
summary.en: Block and hit first: Redoubt for block spikes, Precision so your threat abilities land, and the first point of Shield Specialization to turn blocks into Mana.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，在 Beta 地下城中坦克

pros.zh: 盾牌壁垒让针对你的近战攻击有 10% 几率使格挡几率提高 20%，持续 10 秒或 5 次格挡。
pros.en: Redoubt gives melee attacks against you a 10% chance to raise your block chance by 20% for 10 seconds or 5 blocks.

pros.zh: 精确提供 3% 命中，对建立仇恨的技能尤其重要。
pros.en: Precision adds 3% hit, which matters most on the abilities you build threat with.

pros.zh: 预知提供 8 点防御技能，降低敌人对你暴击和碾压的几率。
pros.en: Anticipation adds 8 Defense Skill, cutting the chance that enemies crit or crush you.

pros.zh: 盾牌专精让约三分之一的格挡回复 6% 最大法力，这正是 20 级解锁奉献后维持输出的关键。
pros.en: Shield Specialization restores 6% of maximum Mana on a third of your blocks, which is what keeps Consecration running once it unlocks at 20.

pros.zh: 单刷任务？惩戒方案的击杀速度快得多；防护的价值体现在地下城队伍里。
pros.en: Questing solo? Retribution kills far faster; Protection earns its points in a dungeon group.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
